messages:
maria: quick sync — i'm planning a weekend rollout for a gateway-scoped routing override to shift some inference traffic to cheaper capacity. want to confirm the safety model. do we gate at the gateway (edge) or at the runtime-config layer? :thinking:

alex: my vote is gateway for fast failback. if we flip at runtime it's slower to converge on thousands of in-flight connections. gateway can short-circuit earlier.

maria: good point. but gateway lacks the rich telemetry we get at runtime-plane. if it misroutes we won't have per-model token breakdowns to detect quality regressions.

devon: can we do hybrid? announce the override at gateway but mark it dry_run so runtime still receives samples and emits the usual metrics. gateway treats dry_run as annotation only.

sam: hybrid sounds right. implementation question: what does the API look like? i want a single PATCH that can express scope=\"gateway\" + dry_run + sampling_pct. something like:
```
PATCH /api/v1/configs/routing/overrides/123
{
  "scope": "gateway",
  "targets": ["gw-nyc-1","gw-sg-1"],
  "sampling_pct": 10,
  "dry_run": true
}
```

tia: +1 for that shape. need to ensure console shows expected per-route delta before merge. UX should estimate token delta and latency delta using recent traffic window.

maria: console estimate is key. ops asked for a peek mode that simulates routing for a 1h window and shows token cost delta and error delta. can we reuse the replay infra?

alex: replay infra works, but it's heavy. alternative: fast approximate estimator that replays prefixes and uses cached kv for kv-cache hit modeling. cheap and probably 90% accurate.

devon: also add guardrail triggers: if error_rate increases > 0.5% or latency p50 increases > 50ms during sampling window, auto-revert or mark rollout as failed. should be configurable per-override.

sam: agree. we need an API field for guardrails. e.g. \"guardrails\": { \"err_pct_delta\": 0.5, \"p50_ms_delta\": 50 } and a runbook link.

maria: ops-bot: can you add a schedule check so weekend rollouts require two approvers and an oncall in the whitelist? @ops-bot

ops-bot: noted. added requirement: weekend_rollout -> approvals: 2, oncall_notify: true. will block apply until satisfied. :white_check_mark:

tia: tiny UX ask: when someone creates a gateway override in dry_run, console should surface a toggle to convert it to enforce with a single click and preserve the sampling history. also show who approved plus the last simulation snapshot.

alex: implementation note: ensure the gateway config push is idempotent and supports diff-only pushes. pushing the whole config will cause brief churn on gateways. we should send a delta and a version header.

devon: and we should attach a correlation-id for tracing through gateway -> runtime -> metrics so rollback windows are easy to query. e.g. X-Override-Id header.

maria: sounds like we have a plan: hybrid dry_run at gateway + sampling to runtime, console simulate/replay estimate, guardrails configurable, approvals for weekend. i'll draft the RFC and the API proto today.

sam: ping me on the proto review. i'll sketch the OpenAPI patch + sample responses.

tia: i'll mock the console peek UI and include the cost delta card.

maria: thanks all. will file the RFC and link back here. :rocket:
